title: PR governance policy
description: Trusted per-repository policy read from the default branch head. Never read from the pull request head.

mode.description: enforce publishes and fails; report-only publishes advisory statuses and never fails the run; local publishes nothing.

reviewer.description: The only fixed identity in the gate. Reviewer-authored evidence is the sole review source.

reviewers.description: Ordered reviewer identities. reviewers[0] must match reviewer. Any listed identity may satisfy ai-review on the current head.

review_routing.description: Dispatch-only hints for the scheduled review nudge; they do not weaken ai-review evidence rules.

owner.description: Optional. The only actor whose label event can claim owner-approved. Prefer setting RISK_GATE_OWNER_ID and RISK_GATE_OWNER as repository or organization variables; the action then replaces this object and the policy carries no account identity.

r0_paths.description: Prose paths that may be classified R0 when the change has no sensitive keyword. Trailing slash matches a prefix.

r2_paths.description: Repository-specific high-risk paths; added to the canonical heuristics.

dependabot_template_exemption.description: Skip the pull request template check for verified Dependabot heads.

max_evidence_age_hours.description: Maximum age of reviewer evidence, in hours.
